text: So sorry to message at this hour, I really hope I'm not wasting your time. I'm a childminder and I'm doing an overnight with a 10 year old boy whose parents are stuck abroad because of a cancelled flight. He's just come to me saying he feels hot and the thermometer says 38.2. His eczema has also flared up, mostly in the creases of his elbows, really dry and he's been scratching. I've put his own cream on him from his bag. I wasn't sure if I should give him something for the temperature or whether I'm allowed to without asking his parents first, they're not answering at the moment. Sorry again, I just didn't want to get it wrong.
